_comment: Reviewed response-body transform hits for the body-wire-naming-conformance-gate. Nothing
here sets a language or a response surface aside: a response-body field that does not
serialize under the declared camelCase rule always fails the gate, and the gate refuses any
key in this file other than _comment and transform_exemptions.
transform_exemptions: every place a language's generated tree spells one of its declared
response_body_transform_idioms (a framework-level transform applied to every outgoing
response body) must be a reviewed entry here -- language, the file's trailing path segments,
the exact matched text, and why the hit leaves every response body untouched. An entry that
matches nothing is stale and fails the gate.

transform_exemptions.reason: Registers the MetricsInterceptor, which times each request and records its metrics from the request and the response status; it never reads or rewrites the handler's returned body.
